task.title: Set the profile identity and schema channel
task.shortdesc: Choose the saved profile name and the Firefox schema channel before you configure guided settings.

prereq.p: Open a new or saved profile in Guided editor.

context.p: Use Step 1, Profile & baseline, to set the name and schema channel that will drive validation and available controls.

step.cmd: Confirm that you are editing the intended profile draft.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.
Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent.

step.cmd: Choose the Firefox schema channel: Release 153, ESR 153.0, ESR 140.13, or ESR 115.39.

info.p: Expected result: the Guided profile remains consistent. ESR 115.39 is for organizations that still need its limited legacy-operating-system critical-security support; it does not extend operating-system vendor support. BPM rechecks that support boundary on 2027-03-01.

step.cmd: Review whether the selected channel changes the visible controls before continuing.

info.note: Changing schema-dependent controls can make values invalid for the selected Firefox channel.

result.p: The Guided draft has a stable identity and schema channel.

postreq.p: Recovery: if controls look different than expected, return to Step 1 and confirm the schema channel before changing settings.
